title: Biome Crystal
description:
The Biome Crystal stores a single biome. It cannot be crafted. It can be found in chests around the world: every vanilla chest loot table (dungeons, mineshafts, temples, villages and so on) has a 20% chance to contain one, tuned to a random biome. Crystals are also available in the creative menu, but those are not tuned to any biome and a Biome Radar will not start a search with them.

The name and tooltip of the crystal show which biome it is tuned to.

Put a Biome Crystal into a Biome Radar to search for that biome. It is also used to craft the Biome Sensor needed for the Biome Radar.
